observation.command:
cd /tmp && rm -f cj.txt
set -a && . /workspace/.env && set +a
echo "=== step1: GET /app/ ==="
curl -s -c cj.txt -b cj.txt -D h1.txt -o /dev/null "http://localhost:3000/app/"
AUTHURL=$(grep -i '^Location:' h1.txt | sed 's/Location: //' | tr -d '\r')
echo "auth url: ${AUTHURL:0:160}..."
STATE=$(echo "$AUTHURL" | sed -n 's/.*state=\([^&]*\).*/\1/p')
echo "state=$STATE"
echo "=== step2: GET keycloak auth page (follow redirects) ==="
curl -s -c cj.txt -b cj.txt -L -D h2.txt -o page.html "$AUTHURL"
grep -i '^Location:' h2.txt | tail -3
echo "--- page title/action ---"
grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' page.html | head -1
grep -o 'action="[^"]*"' page.html | head -3
